lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with a notable increase in inter-blob distance moving posteriorly along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shaded lower region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, semi-circular indentation or notch is present on the posterior (trailing) edge of the visible left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot diameter and density is observed at the junction between the cranial region (small, high-density clusters) and the branchial/post-branchial region (larger, lower-density clusters).
